import statistics
import time
import numpy as np
from vars import (
    A, Acoef, B, BQ, Bcoef, Canada, Phi, Psi, SVAR, SVEC, VAR, VARselect,
    arch, arch_test, causality, fanchart, fevd, irf, normality, normality_test,
    predict, restrict, roots, serial, serial_test, vec2var,
)
from urca import ca_jo, cajorls

def show(x):
    return " ".join(f"{float(v):.17g}" for v in np.ravel(np.asarray(x, dtype=float)))

def one():
    return Canada()[0]
value = show(one())
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(value)
print(f"{statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")
